You are helping a user write SQL queries to a database. If something is not clear, you can ask the user to clarify what they need. The schema for the database being accessed is the following:
        
CREATE TABLE TV_Channel (
    id TEXT   PRIMARY KEY,
    series_name TEXT,
    Country TEXT,
    Language TEXT,
    Content TEXT,
    Pixel_aspect_ratio_PAR TEXT,
    Hight_definition_TV TEXT,
    Pay_per_view_PPV TEXT,
    Package_Option TEXT,
    UNIQUE (id)
);

CREATE TABLE TV_series (
    id REAL   PRIMARY KEY,
    Episode TEXT,
    Air_Date TEXT,
    Rating TEXT,
    Share REAL,
    18_49_Rating_Share TEXT,
    Viewers_m TEXT,
    Weekly_Rank REAL,
    Channel TEXT,
    UNIQUE (id),
    FOREIGN KEY (Channel) REFERENCES TV_Channel(id)
);

CREATE TABLE Cartoon (
    id REAL   PRIMARY KEY,
    Title TEXT,
    Directed_by TEXT,
    Written_by TEXT,
    Original_air_date TEXT,
    Production_code REAL,
    Channel TEXT,
    UNIQUE (id),
    FOREIGN KEY (Channel) REFERENCES TV_Channel(id)
);

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT ch.id, ch.series_name
FROM TV_Channel AS ch
JOIN Cartoon AS c
  ON c.Channel = ch.id
ORDER BY ch.series_name, ch.id;
```
you should check which countries these tv channels are in

```sql
SELECT
  ch.Country,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ch.id) AS cartoon_channel_count
FROM TV_Channel AS ch
JOIN Cartoon AS c
  ON c.Channel = ch.id
GROUP BY ch.Country
ORDER BY cartoon_channel_count DESC, ch.Country;
```
Also, gotta confirm the channels are actually airing those cartoons.

```sql
SELECT
  ch.id AS channel_id,
  ch.series_name AS channel_name,
  ch.Country,
  COUNT(c.id) AS cartoons_listed_on_channel
FROM TV_Channel AS ch
JOIN Cartoon AS c
  ON c.Channel = ch.id          -- confirms the cartoon is linked to that channel
GROUP BY ch.id, ch.series_name, ch.Country
HAVING COUNT(c.id) > 0
ORDER BY cartoons_listed_on_channel DESC, ch.Country, ch.series_name;
```
Also check if those cartoons are written by Todd Casey.

```sql
SELECT
  ch.id AS channel_id,
  ch.series_name AS channel_name,
  ch.Country,
  c.id AS cartoon_id,
  c.Title,
  c.Original_air_date,
  c.Written_by
FROM TV_Channel AS ch
JOIN Cartoon AS c
  ON c.Channel = ch.id
WHERE c.Written_by LIKE '%Todd Casey%'
ORDER BY ch.Country, ch.series_name, c.Title;
```
